verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Ezra 2

Eleven leaders in 2:2, twelve in Neh 7:7 (Nahamani dropped, Kidner); Zerubbabel probably the same as Sheshbazzar (Ezra 5:16 vs 3:8); Jeshua = Joshua of Haggai and Zechariah (Kidner); Arah 775 vs 652 in Neh 7:10 (copyist error or attrition, Poole); three copies of the list (Clarke); Kidner: 42,360 in all three, items total 29,818 (Ezra), 31,089 (Nehemiah), 30,143 (1 Esdras) — explanations "the narrative is silent"; Murashu archives with Jewish names (Yamauchi); population estimates for postexilic Judah 20,000–235,000 (Yamauchi)
